summary: Verified the Unicode-filename Content-Disposition bug fix for the Digital Library (Bibliothèque Numérique). All three target endpoints (proxy/serve/download) return 200 with HTTP-safe headers, and the original 'latin-1 codec can't encode characters' error is gone. Backend unit + integration tests (17/17) and UI verification on /enseignements/ouvrages all pass.

minor.issue: When the file has no stored_filename (URL-based entries, as in the seeded Risâla/Burda/Wazifa), the endpoint falls back to proxy_external_file() which sets Content-Disposition: inline instead of attachment. Result: clicking 'Download' may render the PDF in-browser rather than forcing a save. Suggested fix: in download_library_file fallback, build the response inline with get_safe_filename_header(filename, 'attachment').

Proxy loads the full remote file into memory before streaming (io.BytesIO(response.content)) – the Risâla file is reported as 189 MB which will cause backend memory pressure and slow first-byte time. Consider switching to client.stream() and yielding chunks.

verified_endpoints./api/ouvrages/external-library/proxy/{id: 200, application/pdf, CD inline; filename="*.pdf" (latin-1 safe) for all 3 ids
verified_endpoints./api/ouvrages/external-library/serve/{id: 200, application/pdf, CD inline; filename="*.pdf" (latin-1 safe) for all 3 ids
verified_endpoints./api/ouvrages/external-library/download/: 200, application/pdf, CD inline (fallback) – see minor issue above
verified_endpoints.Negative cases: 404 returned for non-existent ids on all 3 endpoints

ui_verification.preview_buttons: All 3 generate correct proxy URLs (window.open intercepted, URLs verified)
ui_verification.preview_response: 200, application/pdf, valid Content-Disposition for all 3 files

action_items: MINOR: Fix download_library_file fallback to force 'attachment' disposition even when delegating to proxy_external_file (currently inherits 'inline').
MINOR (performance): Stream upstream PDF in proxy_external_file instead of buffering 189 MB in memory.
Optional: Add an end-to-end Cypress/Playwright check that the Download button actually triggers a browser download for URL-based files.
critical_code_review_comments: get_safe_filename_header correctly implements RFC 5987 (ASCII fallback + filename*=UTF-8''<percent-encoded>). The encode('ascii','ignore') fallback can produce a confusing pure-punctuation name (e.g., 'Risla - .pdf') – functional but UX could be improved by using unicodedata transliteration.
proxy_external_file uses response.content (whole file in memory). For the Risâla file (189 MB) this is risky in a multi-worker container.
download_library_file does not honor 'attachment' when falling back to proxy – breaks the semantic of a Download button for non-uploaded files.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Digital Library renders 3 files, Preview URLs return valid PDFs, no JS errors)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Existing seeded files used: Risâla (ea09d162…), Qaṣīdat al-Burda (ad993f92…), Dou'a wa Wazîfa (027608af…).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Unicode-encoding bug is fully fixed. If revisiting: (1) the seeded test files have ASCII filenames stored in DB ('Fakhiatul_Tullab.pdf' etc.), so the production HTTP response Content-Disposition values are pure ASCII; the actual Arabic-in-filename scenario was validated via direct unit tests of get_safe_filename_header. (2) Download endpoint falls back to inline for URL-based items – see minor issue. (3) Proxy loads entire remote file in memory – consider streaming.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI/Starlette encodes response headers as latin-1. Filenames containing Arabic or other non-Latin-1 characters cannot be placed directly into the Content-Disposition value, raising UnicodeEncodeError ('latin-1' codec can't encode characters in position 31-34: ordinal not in range(256)).
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added get_safe_filename_header() helper that detects non-ASCII filenames and emits RFC 5987 compliant headers: an ASCII-only filename= fallback plus filename*=UTF-8''<percent-encoded>. Helper is used in proxy_external_file, serve_library_file, download_library_file, and download_pdf.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction_blocked_because: Verified via direct unit tests that get_safe_filename_header('الرسالة.pdf', ...) and ('Risâla - الرسالة.pdf', ...) produce latin-1-encodable headers (header.encode('latin-1') succeeds).
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: No further changes required for the reported bug. Address the minor items above for hardening.
